reviews.text: My dog Louie needed a dental surgery. They removed his baby tooth that was not falling out it was messing up the growth of his adult tooth. They were supper nice and professional. The doctor and the staff are very kind and knowledgeable. This is a great vet for your animals

Dr. Ryszard is phenomenal. His proactive approaches to our dogs have been beyond attentive as well as incredibly informative.

My mom's dog was recently diagnosed with cancer and due to Dr. Ryszard's quick thinking, schedule rearrangements, and attention to detail, her dog has been almost 1 month pain free after pursuing an amputation on his leg.

Even the oncologist at MedVet applauded how quickly and smoothly the amputation was made. It was brilliantly clean on the pathology smears and her dog healed very quickly without any post-op infections.

Dr. Ryszard was very thorough on each check up, and if there was any hesitance from his end he scheduled us sooner or would let us know immediately. This was incredibly important to us. He treated our dog as if it was a part of his own family.

The staff was also very kind helping us with the scheduling and follow-ups.

If every human was getting the kind of attention to detail as our dog Scooby did by Dr. Ryszard, we would all live in a better world.

Thank you all so much!

Dr. Ryszard is an exceptional specialist. His proactive approach to our dogs was not only incredibly attentive but also very educational.
My mother's dog was recently diagnosed with cancer. Thanks to Dr. Ryszard's quick response, careful scheduling, and attention to detail, the dog remained pain-free for almost a month after the decision was made to amputate.

Even the oncologist at MedVet commented on how efficiently the procedure was performed. The amputation was performed with great precision, in line with pathological examinations, and the healing process was rapid and without complications such as infection.
Dr. Ryszard demonstrated great meticulousness during each follow-up visit—if there were any concerns, he responded immediately, expediting the appointment or contacting us without delay. This was incredibly important to us. He treated our dog as if he were a member of his own family.

If every patient received the care and attention that our dog Scooby received from Dr. Ryszard, the world would be a much better place.
Very poor service, I waited for over an hour and no one ever attended to me. They do their own things and talk first, and then the work comes later.
They’re really awesome idk the bad reviews
They always do good job and take us in

It is a shame and a tragedy that this place lends itself to such practices. They don't care about your pets here; they only want your money. We have been clients of this clinic, but whenever you call to schedule an appointment, they never make any effort to help. They just want you to come in through the emergency room so they can charge you more money. The people who work here lack the necessary sensitivity to care for your pets. Definitely do not take your pets to this place. This veterinary clinic only wants your money

I do not recommend this place. I took my dogs there for the first time, and everything seemed to go very well; however, a year later, I called regarding an emergency with one of my dogs, and they told me they didn't have any appointments available for another two weeks. They didn't care that my pet needed immediate attention.
And today, 04/10/26, I called to schedule a routine appointment for one of my dogs—specifically because a lump had appeared on his neck, just below his throat—and they told me they don't have any appointments available until the end of June. Seriously?

The receptionists make no effort to schedule an emergency appointment, nor do they try to find a way to fit one in as soon as possible; they simply tell you, "We have no appointments—we're fully booked"—and that's it. No matter the nature of your emergency, this veterinary clinic lacks empathy toward its clients, and even more so toward the needs of their pets.
Staff is friendly and helpful.  They are knowledgeable and handle your pet with care.

Dr. Angie has the biggest heart of any vet I have seen in Chicago. I had been searching everywhere for an affordable clinic to take my furbaby Sulli Bear in for her emergency. Everyone turned me away, due to not having enough funds to get her treated EXCEPT Dr. Angie. Unfortunately I had to make the hard decision to have  my furbaby put down, but Dr. Angie looked out for me and helped as much as she possibly could with what I had. I will be using this establishment for any/all future furbaby endeavors. Thank you for all your help Dr. Angie and staff at Brighton Park Animal Hospital. My baby is no longer suffering thanks to you <3 God bless you.

Came in at 3 pm when they are open til 5 pm and they couldn’t take my dog in because they are closing in 2 hours… also referred us to an “animal clinic” that turned out to be a dog pound. Receptionist definitely did not want customers so I would stay away from here if you want to walk in.

I took my 1 year old dog here for the second time because he had an ear infection and when he had came back out from the room he was in he looked really scared and he just wanted to get out of there already, when we got back home he was just laying down sad when he’s usually so energetic no matter what, and he’s just been really sad and scared, and he’s been using the bathroom inside my house which he never does because we take him outside and because he’s trained already as well he just stays under my bed all day and doesn’t want to come out when I call him because he’s scared. I really don’t know what they did to my poor baby but my dog wasn’t like this until I took him to this place. DONT TAKE YOUR DOG HERE!!!

WOW...I'm too hurt...and still don't know what to do.

I love, love, love this vet clinic. Everyone is so kind and they do an excellent job. My pups are always treated so well and all the Dr.'s and nurses really know their stuff. I highly recommend this clinic.
I am VERY happy with how they treat my dog ​​and me; everyone is very attentive, especially the doctors.

I have two pets that come here. One is a senior dog who’s been going here since he was a puppy. We’ve never had any issues with staff or appointments. He was operated on at his older age. The doctor was very informative and transparent with all the risks and aftermath of the surgery. Regular checkups and vaccines are average/affordable. Obviously more complicated things and bigger procedures are expensive but thankfully I’ve been able to manage. My other pet is a young, sweet, shy girl but they are ever so gentle with her (as well as my other one. The care and love they demonstrate while attending them is touching). I am very thankful to have a vet hospital that’s dependable.
Kind, Quick, and Respectful. Been there with my dog many times.

If you don't want to spend a fortune, I wouldn't recommend bringing your pet here. I can't complain about the service, the staff and the person who examined my cat were friendly, but they were very money-driven. Every time I went for a follow-up, especially during the first visit, they kept pushing unnecessary treatments that my cat didn't need. You could argue that it's better to be safe than sorry, but when most of these recommended procedures cost between $100 and $400 and my cat didn't actually need them, it felt like a waste of money and them just being money hungry. If you're knowledgeable about your pet's needs, this place might work for you, but for most people, it's easy to get talked into paying for unnecessary treatments. Also, when it comes to medication, if they say they carry it, ask for the name and a prescription instead. You can often find it online for $10–$50 less than what they charge.
